answer: To achieve Sybil resistance among autonomous agents, we implement a multi-tiered stake terrace where agents commit capital to a state bridge. Attackers registering multiple identities face exponential slashing. If an agent submits conflicting attestations, a relic epoch key is exposed, triggering a zero-knowledge proof of malfeasance. This guarantees that the cost of attack exceeds any Byzantine utility, enforcing a stable Nash equilibrium.
